description: Eurolite LED 4C-7 Silent Slim Spot (7 x 8 W RGBW, fanless). Five DMX modes (3, 4, 5, 6, 9 channels); the menu 'Addr' of the fixture picks one, the Rig page must say the same. 4CH (plain RGBW) is the default.

modes.name: 4CH
modes.description: Red, green, blue, white. The plain colour mode.

modes.name: 5CH
modes.description: Master dimmer (follows the brightness), strobe, preset colour held at White, program and speed off. No colour mixing.

modes.name: 6CH
modes.description: Red, green, blue, white, master dimmer (held at full), function (strobe).

modes.name: 9CH
modes.description: Master dimmer (held at full), strobe, red, green, blue, white, preset colour, program and speed (these three off).

_note: Modes and channel tables from the manual 00123366 v1.0 (raw/fixtures/Eurolite_LED_4C-7.pdf in the PitchPlease wiki). Value 0-9 of the preset colour, program and function channels is 'no function'; preset colour 190-255 = White.
